title: Datenight Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=datenight:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for datenight metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for datenight metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from datenight metric1 (1).
